question: List the names of all students who are in the Electronics Engineering department.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM students WHERE department = 'Electronics Engineering';

question: Give the names of students whose average marks are above 90.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM students WHERE average_marks > 90;

question: Show the names of students whose pending fees are between 1000 and 5000.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM students WHERE pending_fees BETWEEN 1000 AND 5000;

question: Which student names have attendance percentage less than 80?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM students WHERE attendance_percentage < 80;

question: List the names of students in Computer Engineering or Electronics Engineering whose average marks are at least 90.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM students WHERE department IN ('Computer Engineering', 'Electronics Engineering') AND average_marks >= 90;

question: Give the names of students who owe fees and whose attendance is below 90.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM students WHERE pending_fees > 0 AND attendance_percentage < 90;

question: Which students' names start with the letter A?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM students WHERE name LIKE 'A%';

question: What is the overall average attendance of the students?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(attendance_percentage) FROM students;

question: What is the total pending fees across all students?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(pending_fees) FROM students;

question: How many students have pending fees greater than zero?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM students WHERE pending_fees > 0;

question: What is the highest average marks recorded?
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(average_marks) FROM students;

question: What is the difference between the highest and lowest attendance percentages?
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(attendance_percentage) - MIN(attendance_percentage) FROM students;

question: How many students are named Meera?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM students WHERE name LIKE '%Meera%';

question: What is the average assignment score for each department?
gold_sql: SELECT department, AVG(assignment_score) FROM students GROUP BY department;

question: Which departments have a total pending fees above 10000?
gold_sql: SELECT department FROM students GROUP BY department HAVING SUM(pending_fees) > 10000;

question: Which departments have an average attendance below 87?
gold_sql: SELECT department FROM students GROUP BY department HAVING AVG(attendance_percentage) < 87;

question: For each department, how many students owe fees?
gold_sql: SELECT department, COUNT(*) FROM students WHERE pending_fees > 0 GROUP BY department;

question: Which departments have more than 4 students?
gold_sql: SELECT department FROM students GROUP BY department HAVING COUNT(*) > 4;

question: Give the names and departments of students whose pending fees are above the average pending fees of their department.
gold_sql: SELECT name, department FROM students s WHERE pending_fees > (SELECT AVG(pending_fees) FROM students w WHERE w.department = s.department);

question: Give the names of the three students with the highest attendance.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM students ORDER BY attendance_percentage DESC, name LIMIT 3;

question: Which student owes the most in pending fees? Give the name.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM students ORDER BY pending_fees DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Give the names of the top 2 students by assignment score.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM students ORDER BY assignment_score DESC, name LIMIT 2;

question: Give the names of the three students with the lowest average marks.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM students ORDER BY average_marks ASC, name LIMIT 3;

question: Give the name of the student who has the fifth highest attendance percentage.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM students ORDER BY attendance_percentage DESC, name LIMIT 1 OFFSET 4;

question: List each course name together with the number of students enrolled in it, including courses with no enrollments.
gold_sql: SELECT c.course_name, COUNT(e.enrollment_id) FROM courses c LEFT JOIN enrollments e ON e.course_id = c.course_id GROUP BY c.course_id, c.course_name ORDER BY c.course_name;

question: Which course names had no enrolled students?
gold_sql: SELECT course_name FROM courses WHERE course_id NOT IN (SELECT course_id FROM enrollments);

question: What are the names of students enrolled in more than one course?
gold_sql: SELECT s.name FROM students s JOIN enrollments e ON e.student_id = s.student_id GROUP BY s.student_id, s.name HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

question: How many students are enrolled in the Data Structures course?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enrollments e JOIN courses c ON c.course_id = e.course_id WHERE c.course_name = 'Data Structures';

question: What is the average enrollment marks of each course, including courses with no enrolled students?
gold_sql: SELECT c.course_name, AVG(e.marks) FROM courses c LEFT JOIN enrollments e ON e.course_id = c.course_id GROUP BY c.course_id, c.course_name ORDER BY c.course_name;

question: List the student names with their course names for every enrollment.
gold_sql: SELECT s.name, c.course_name FROM enrollments e JOIN students s ON s.student_id = e.student_id JOIN courses c ON c.course_id = e.course_id;

question: How many books are written by R. Srinivasan?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM books WHERE author = 'R. Srinivasan';

question: How many loans are still open (never returned)?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loans WHERE returned_on IS NULL;

question: Which members joined in 2023 after March? List their names.
gold_sql: SELECT member_name FROM members WHERE joined_on > '2023-03-31';

question: List all books whose available copies are less than total copies.
gold_sql: SELECT title FROM books WHERE copies_available < copies_total;

question: Which books have no copies available right now?
gold_sql: SELECT title FROM books WHERE copies_available = 0;

question: How many loans were returned after their due date?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loans WHERE returned_on > due_on;

question: Who returned a book late? Give me the member names.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT m.member_name FROM loans l JOIN members m ON l.member_id = m.member_id WHERE l.returned_on > l.due_on;

question: For each genre, how many books does the library own?
gold_sql: SELECT genre, COUNT(*) FROM books GROUP BY genre;

question: List genres that own at least two distinct titles.
gold_sql: SELECT genre, COUNT(*) AS n FROM books GROUP BY genre HAVING n >= 2;

question: Show the number of loans per member, sorted from most to least.
gold_sql: SELECT m.member_name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM loans l JOIN members m ON l.member_id = m.member_id GROUP BY m.member_id ORDER BY n DESC;

question: Which author has the most copies owned by the library?
gold_sql: SELECT author, SUM(copies_total) AS t FROM books GROUP BY author ORDER BY t DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Top 2 oldest books by publication year.
gold_sql: SELECT title, publication_year FROM books ORDER BY publication_year ASC LIMIT 2;

question: How many members are currently active?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM members WHERE active = 1;

question: List the titles of every book borrowed by members named Dev Menon.
gold_sql: SELECT b.title FROM loans l JOIN members m ON l.member_id = m.member_id JOIN books b ON l.book_id = b.book_id WHERE m.member_name = 'Dev Menon';

question: Average publication year of Science books.
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(publication_year) FROM books WHERE genre = 'Science';

question: Which member borrowed the greatest number of distinct books?
gold_sql: SELECT member_id FROM loans GROUP BY member_id ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT book_id) DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Loans that were due in February 2024 — list loan ids.
gold_sql: SELECT loan_id FROM loans WHERE due_on LIKE '2024-02-%';

question: For each book, how many times has it been loaned out?
gold_sql: SELECT book_id, COUNT(*) FROM loans GROUP BY book_id;

question: Books that have never been loaned (list titles).
gold_sql: SELECT title FROM books WHERE book_id NOT IN (SELECT book_id FROM loans);

question: Total copies available across the whole library.
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(copies_available) FROM books;

question: List members who joined in the first half of 2023 (names, join dates).
gold_sql: SELECT member_name, joined_on FROM members WHERE joined_on <= '2023-06-30' ORDER BY joined_on;

question: How many customers are from Delhi?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE city = 'Delhi';

question: List product names with zero stock.
gold_sql: SELECT product_name FROM products WHERE units_in_stock = 0;

question: Which orders were placed in March 2024? Give order ids.
gold_sql: SELECT order_id FROM orders WHERE order_date LIKE '2024-03-%';

question: Total quantity of items ordered across all orders.
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(quantity) FROM order_items;

question: What is the average unit price of Electronics products?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(unit_price) FROM products WHERE category = 'Electronics';

question: List each order id with its total amount (sum of quantity times price).
gold_sql: SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price) AS total FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id ORDER BY order_id;

question: Which customer spent the most across all their orders (total value)?
gold_sql: SELECT o.customer_id FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY o.customer_id ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Top 3 most expensive products by unit price.
gold_sql: SELECT product_name, unit_price FROM products ORDER BY unit_price DESC LIMIT 3;

question: How many orders are still pending?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'pending';

question: For each status, how many orders?
gold_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY status;

question: Which cities have more than one customer? Show city and the count.
gold_sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers GROUP BY city HAVING n > 1;

question: List Electronics product names along with how many units remain.
gold_sql: SELECT product_name, units_in_stock FROM products WHERE category = 'Electronics' ORDER BY product_name;

question: Which customer from Pune has never placed an order (name)?
gold_sql: SELECT customer_name FROM customers WHERE city = 'Pune' AND customer_id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders);

question: Product names ordered on 2024-02-02.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.product_name FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.order_date = '2024-02-02';

question: How many distinct products have been ordered at least once?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) FROM order_items;

question: For every product, how many units were sold in total?
gold_sql: SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) FROM order_items GROUP BY product_id;

question: Customers who signed up in 2023 — names and dates, newest first.
gold_sql: SELECT customer_name, signup_date FROM customers ORDER BY signup_date DESC;

question: What's the total inventory value (stock times price) per category?
gold_sql: SELECT category, SUM(units_in_stock * unit_price) FROM products GROUP BY category;

question: Which order contains the highest single item-quantity line?
gold_sql: SELECT order_id FROM order_items ORDER BY quantity DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Average order value (sum over items) across all orders.
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(total) FROM (SELECT SUM(quantity * unit_price) AS total FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id);

question: List the product names bought by Asha Iyer.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.product_name FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.customer_name = 'Asha Iyer';

question: How many items does each order have (count of lines)?
gold_sql: SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id;

question: Which pending orders belong to Delhi customers (order ids)?
gold_sql: SELECT o.order_id FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'pending' AND c.city = 'Delhi';

question: Coolest product name alphabetically last.
gold_sql: SELECT product_name FROM products ORDER BY product_name DESC LIMIT 1;

question: For every course, how many students are enrolled? Show course name and count.
gold_sql: SELECT c.course_name, COUNT(*) FROM courses c JOIN enrollments e ON e.course_id = c.course_id GROUP BY c.course_id ORDER BY c.course_id;

question: List each student's name with the number of courses they take.
gold_sql: SELECT s.name, COUNT(*) FROM students s JOIN enrollments e ON e.student_id = s.student_id GROUP BY s.student_id ORDER BY s.name;

question: Which students take no course at all? List their names.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM students WHERE student_id NOT IN (SELECT student_id FROM enrollments);

question: What is the average marks students scored in each department's courses (students joined to enrollments)?
gold_sql: SELECT s.department, AVG(e.marks) FROM students s JOIN enrollments e ON e.student_id = s.student_id GROUP BY s.department;

question: Which course is the most enrolled, by enrollment count?
gold_sql: SELECT course_id FROM enrollments GROUP BY course_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;

question: For each department, how many credits do its courses offer in total?
gold_sql: SELECT department, SUM(credits) FROM courses GROUP BY department;

question: Show students who scored above 90 in any enrollment (name and that mark).
gold_sql: SELECT s.name, e.marks FROM students s JOIN enrollments e ON e.student_id = s.student_id WHERE e.marks > 90;

question: Which departments offer the most courses (name plus count, top 2)?
gold_sql: SELECT department, COUNT(*) AS n FROM courses GROUP BY department ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 2;

question: Which student has the highest attendance percentage?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM students ORDER BY attendance_percentage DESC LIMIT 1;

question: How much pending fees is outstanding in total across all students?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(pending_fees) FROM students;

question: Which authors have written more than one book in the library?
gold_sql: SELECT author FROM books GROUP BY author HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

question: Members who have never borrowed anything — list their names.
gold_sql: SELECT member_name FROM members WHERE member_id NOT IN (SELECT member_id FROM loans);

question: Which books were borrowed by more than one different member?
gold_sql: SELECT book_id FROM loans GROUP BY book_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) > 1;

question: List every loan that was returned late, with loan ids.
gold_sql: SELECT loan_id FROM loans WHERE returned_on > due_on;

question: Sort the books by copies available, most available first.
gold_sql: SELECT title FROM books ORDER BY copies_available DESC;

question: Which member is the most recent one to join (name and date)?
gold_sql: SELECT member_name, joined_on FROM members ORDER BY joined_on DESC LIMIT 1;

question: How many distinct authors does the library currently hold?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT author) FROM books;

question: Books whose title contains the word 'Turing'.
gold_sql: SELECT title FROM books WHERE title LIKE '%Turing%';

question: Total number of loans per month of the loan date (year-month).
gold_sql: SELECT SUBSTR(loaned_on, 1, 7) AS ym, COUNT(*) FROM loans GROUP BY ym ORDER BY ym;

question: Which products are low on stock (fewer than 15 units)? List names.
gold_sql: SELECT product_name FROM products WHERE units_in_stock < 15;

question: For each city, what is the total value of goods its customers ordered?
gold_sql: SELECT c.city, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY c.city;

question: Customers with more than one order — names and their order counts.
gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id HAVING n > 1;

question: What is the total value of items in pending orders?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'pending';

question: Which product was ordered by the greatest number of distinct orders?
gold_sql: SELECT product_id FROM order_items GROUP BY product_id ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) DESC, product_id LIMIT 1;

question: Enrollment counts for courses of the Computer Engineering department.
gold_sql: SELECT c.course_name, COUNT(*) FROM courses c JOIN enrollments e ON e.course_id = c.course_id WHERE c.department = 'Computer Engineering' GROUP BY c.course_id ORDER BY c.course_name;

question: Which course carries the highest total marks across its enrollments?
gold_sql: SELECT e.course_id FROM enrollments e GROUP BY e.course_id ORDER BY SUM(e.marks) DESC LIMIT 1;
